title: A Brainless Blob Redesigned Tokyo's Rail Network

scenes.text: A blob with no brain redesigned Tokyo's rail map.
It's a slime mold, a single-celled organism.
Scientists laid out food where Tokyo's major cities sit.
They shone light on the mountains and lakes it avoids.
The slime mold spread out, then trimmed itself into a network.
It looked strikingly like Tokyo's real rail system.
No brain, and it matched human engineers.

description:
A blob with no brain redesigned Tokyo's rail map.
Researchers placed food where major cities sit, and a slime mold grew a network strikingly similar to the real rail system.
What else could a blob design for us?
first_comment: Bonus: the research was published in Science in 2010. What should the blob design next?
